name: ether-wand
features: Play starts a tone where tilting the phone controls pitch, roll controls volume and shake adds vibrato.
Pitch and Hz readout update live.
Scale modes include glide, notes and pentatonic, with dark, low, mid and high ranges.
Effects pick clean, classic, space and fuzz.
Demo mode plays routines with tempo, tap tempo and a metronome.
Re-center, flip pitch and use touch fallback work.
